$description: maho core design token contract. SINGLE SOURCE for the STRUCTURE shared across all surfaces (Native C++, WebUI, web-ai, website): spacing scale, radius scale, semantic color roles, motion. Per-surface VALUES (dark background, accent, fonts) are intentionally NOT unified here — each surface overrides via its own layer (see token-conflict-matrix-2026-07.md). This file defines the contract; surfaces fill the values.

$extensions.maho.note: Values marked {{surface}} are override slots — each surface MUST supply its own. Values with concrete tokens are the unified contract (do not diverge per surface).

space.$description: Unified 4px-base spacing scale. Replaces per-surface --maho-settings-space-* / --maho-ai-space-* namespaces (the space-7 32-vs-28 bug). All surfaces map to THESE names.

radius.$description: Unified radius scale. Surfaces may scale the base but keep these step names. pill is universal.

semantic.$description: Semantic color ROLES (unified vocabulary). Values default to Apple system palette (web-ai baseline, HIG-aligned); WebUI/Native may re-tint but MUST keep the role names.

motion.$description: Unified motion durations + standard easing. Shared across surfaces.

role.$description: Semantic surface/text/border ROLES — the shared vocabulary every surface must expose. VALUES are override slots ({{surface}}): each surface supplies its own hex because backgrounds/accents are intentionally different (Native purple-tint, WebUI neutral, web-ai Apple-gray, website monochrome). This unifies the NAMES, not the values.

background.$description: Primary surface bg. Native #100f15 / WebUI #1a1a1a / web-ai #1c1c1e / website monochrome.

foreground.$description: Primary text. Must hit WCAG AA (4.5:1) on background per surface.

accent.$description: Native=dynamic Space theme / WebUI=neutral #e5e5e5 / web-ai=Apple blue #0a84ff / website=monochrome+OG violet #8b7ff5. NOT unified by design.
